description: The Spanish ministry responsible for telecommunications publishes an annual report on broadband coverage in Spain, with editions from 2012 to 2025, together with aggregated coverage maps and maps of broadband services. The data behind the reports are published as two spreadsheets prepared for the national open data portal: coverage from 2021 to 2025 (6.5 MB) and from 2013 to 2020 (42.6 MB), each broken down by municipality, province, autonomous community and the whole country; both files were updated in June 2026. The coverage figures give the share of population or households able to get broadband by technology and speed class, fixed and mobile, and underpin the designation of white, grey and black areas for the ÚNICO and PEBA-NGA public funding programmes listed on the same pages. Coverage: all of Spain. Format and access: XLSX files, PDF reports and web maps, free. Caveats: coverage is reported by operators and processed by the ministry; categories and speed thresholds have changed between editions, and the exact reference date and technology list were not read in this pass. Simulation uses: municipal exposure of population to loss of fixed or mobile broadband, identification of areas with a single technology, and planning of resilient rural connectivity. Related records: the CNMC geographic statistics and the Infoantenas radio station data describe Spanish networks, and the German, Czech and Austrian broadband atlases are neighbouring equivalents.
